Players Committee card image of [[Mustafar]], as first published (no errata mark), printing: Light Side: “While Vader on table, unless Amidala at a Mustafar location, Force drain -1 here.” Dark Side: “Once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ a Mustafar site.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/mustafar.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/mustafar.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
